note: Crypto instruments: how each one moves (transaction model) and what that means for screening and tracing. kind and model are definitions; freeze and sanction facts carry their source.

instruments.name: Bitcoin
instruments.traceable: yes: public ledger; one transaction spends inputs and creates outputs, so change outputs and peeling chains appear
instruments.risk: Clustering of addresses and change detection matter; mixers (CoinJoin) break the trail.

instruments.name: Ether
instruments.traceable: yes: public ledger; balances per account, transfers also inside smart contracts (internal transactions)
instruments.risk: Swaps and bridges run through contracts; a transfer to a contract is not a transfer to a person.

instruments.name: Tron
instruments.risk: Mostly used to pay fees for TRC-20 transfers.

instruments.name: Tether USD (ERC-20)
instruments.freeze_basis: the token contract has a blacklist function the issuer controls
instruments.traceable: yes: token transfers are events of the contract
instruments.risk: Issuer-controlled: addresses can be frozen. Misuse of stablecoins by illicit actors keeps increasing (FATF 2026).

instruments.name: Tether USD (TRC-20)
instruments.freeze_basis: the token contract has a blacklist function the issuer controls
instruments.risk: The most used rail for USD stablecoin transfers in the traced cases (Garantex, Grinex).

instruments.name: USD Coin (ERC-20)
instruments.freeze_basis: the token contract has a blacklist function the issuer controls
instruments.risk: Issuer-controlled; an e-money token under MiCA in the EU.

instruments.name: A7A5 (rouble-pegged token)

sanctioned.what: transaction ban on A7A5 in the 19th sanctions package (announced 2025-10-23)

instruments.risk: Issuer and main trading venue (Grinex) are on the OFAC and EU lists. In the traces it shows as an unverified token: its contract is still to be matched.

instruments.name: Monero
instruments.traceable: no: amounts and parties are hidden on chain
instruments.risk: An anonymity-enhanced coin: FATF names conversion into privacy coins a red flag. Casefold can recognise the address, not trace it.
